name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the bar across your upper back, take an even grip and stand with feet shoulder-width apart slightly ahead of the rails.
Release the hooks, brace your trunk and bend your hips and knees together.
Descend as far as you can keep your feet flat and your pelvis steady.
Drive evenly through your midfoot and heels to extend your legs smoothly back to standing.
tips: Place your feet slightly ahead of the vertical bar path so your torso stays balanced and comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes throughout the entire squat.
